title: Refuse readings that cite repo files absent at the base commit
summary: Root cause: reading acceptance never compares the files a reading says exist (often from an earlier job such as 20261026-042558-5p65, 20261026-064950-38jx or 20261026-065228-02zf) with the base commit, so a reading built on unlanded work is accepted and only the critic notices. Add a deterministic check, `check_cited_paths_exist`, to `check_reading_acceptance`. It refuses any `crates/...` path named in the reading's assumptions that is not in the base-commit file set and is not a `create` deliverable.

defaults_applied.how: Check and tests are written in Rust.
Tests added; cargo test and clippy must be clean.
The check sits at reading acceptance, where the cause originates.
The rule is enforced by a code check, not prose.
Criteria run the check on readings and see refusal.
The outcome is that unverified dependencies are refused.
One focused check in one file.
Doc comment explains the cause for outside readers.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Goal and audience: the Athena maintainer wants readings built on unlanded earlier-job work caught at reading acceptance, deterministically and before the planner and critic spend a round. The check fixes the class, not one job.

Code survey: I read crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs. `check_reading_acceptance` (line 2849) runs check_prior_result_and_scope, check_criteria_evidence, check_code_survey, check_governance_coverage and then check_boundary_and_repo_files. `repo_files` is the `Option<&BTreeSet<String>>` of base-commit paths, and `path_exists_in` (line 2742) tests membership. The new check goes in the same function after the existing checks. It reads assumptions and deliverables only, calls no model, and applies only when `repo_files` is Some, a capability is set and no question is set. The job adds no record or data file, so `check_record_file` and `AnyRecord` are not involved. The property is measured directly by calling the check on a Reading with a fake file set.

Only `crates/`-prefixed path tokens in assumptions are checked, to avoid false positives on prose. A path passes if it exists in repo_files, is a directory holding files, or is a `create` deliverable of the reading.

The refusal message names each missing path, says it is not at the base commit, and tells the reader to list the earlier job's work as a create deliverable or drop the dependency. Prior-job landing state is not looked up, because the file set at the base commit is the ground truth.

Previous jobs: 20261026-042558-5p65 (failed unverified), 20261026-064950-38jx (rejected) and 20261026-065228-02zf (failed unverified) are the referenced jobs. Their findings (design-review role absent, `resolved` state absent, low-disk test failure) are instances of the class. They are not re-done here. No file their candidates changed is touched; the code-health work of 38jx is dropped from this change, and no code_health.rs, status.rs, steward.rs or gh.rs edit belongs to it.
Governance files (athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows) are not needed; the check is code only.

acceptance_criteria.text: Run `cargo test -p athena-core reading`: a new test builds a reading whose assumption says `crates/athena-core/src/code_health.rs` already exists, with a file set lacking it, and `check_reading_acceptance` returns an error naming that path. The same test passes when the path is in the file set, and when it is a create deliverable.
Run `cargo test -p athena-core reading`: a second test uses a different path and a different earlier job id than the first, and is refused the same way, so the check covers the class and not one job.
Run `cargo test -p athena-core reading`: the check is skipped when repo_files is None, when a question is set and when capability is null, shown by tests that return Ok.
Run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo test --locked`: all pass, and the replay tests in reading.rs still pass.

The change adds a refusal rule, so it refuses more readings and the higher refusal rate is intended: expected 5% of newly refused readings. The replay test over accepted readings stays under the hold limit.

The doc comment on the new `check_cited_paths_exist` in crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs names the root cause (nothing checked a reading's dependencies on earlier jobs against the repo), and CHANGELOG.md has an entry that says the same.

out_of_scope: Rebuilding the code-health check from 20261026-042558-5p65 / 20261026-064950-38jx, or its files (code_health.rs, status.rs, steward.rs, gh.rs, display.rs, Cargo.lock, code_health_hooks.rs): dropped here
Retrying the post-mortem and retry-findings job 20261026-065228-02zf and the files it touched
Fixing the low-disk guard failure in crates/athena-cli/tests/binary.rs
Checking queue state or landing state of earlier jobs
Changing athena.toml, defaults.toml or prompt files
departures: Slightly lower acceptance: the request is vague and the reading picks a path-existence design; the failure class is broader than paths.
urgent_reason: Cuts repeated planning stops: the critic has rejected readings six times for this one cause, each costing a failed or redone attempt.
hard_reason: It adds a rule that can refuse readings at acceptance, which is part of the run pipeline and the gate on how jobs are read.
